comment: Checked-in regression baseline for supabase/scripts/replay-templates.ts and tests/parser_test.ts. One entry per ACTIVE live parser_templates row (202608180004, 202609010001, 202609010003, 202609050001, 202609080001); CIMB v2 is deactivated and intentionally omitted. sample_input is the SANITIZED capture (agents.md §8) taken from supabase/data.sql, and sample_title is the notification title that goes with it — parser_templates has no title column, so a title-gated template's sample title lives only here. body_pattern uses JS named groups and \s because the harness runs the pure functions/parse-notification/parser.ts; the live PL/pgSQL templates use positional groups + field_map and Postgres [[:space:]] instead, so these are a faithful JS-side mirror, not a drop-in. Keep in sync with the migrations.

templates.sample_input: HOO JET YUNG has transferred RM 1.00 to you. Tap here to check the transaction details.
templates.notes: p2p receive: <sender> has transferred RM <amount> to you (credit).

templates.sample_input: You have paid RM12.50 to KEDAI KOPI 66.
You have paid RM29.16 at PINDUODUO
You have successfully transferred RM 100.00 to HOO JET YUNG.
templates.notes: TnG DuitNow outbound transfer to a recipient (debit) — a bare "transferred" is NOT credit.

templates.sample_title: Payment To: Berjaya Starbucks Coffee Company Sdn Bhd
templates.sample_input: Berjaya Starbucks Coffee Company Sdn Bhd: RM20.00 has been deducted from your TNG eWallet. Merchant Reference No. [REDACTED-ACCOUNT]
templates.notes: TnG "Payment To <merchant>: RM X has been deducted...".

sample_expected.merchant_raw: Berjaya Starbucks Coffee Company Sdn Bhd

templates.sample_input: RM 50.00 has been successfully transferred to ONG POOK HUN.
templates.notes: TnG outbound "<amount> has been successfully transferred to <recipient>." (amount-first, debit).

templates.sample_input: You have paid RM40.00 for RON95.
templates.notes: TnG outbound "paid ... for <item>" (e.g. petrol, bill). The live row also carries reject_pattern (marketing/reward keyword guard); parser.ts does not implement that pre-check.

templates.sample_input: DuitNow to Acct RM 1.00 to HOO JET YUNG/Touch n Go on 30-Aug-2026, 01:22:56. Call the no at the back of your card for queries.
templates.notes: DuitNow outbound transfer to an account/wallet; txn_date is local MYT (migration 202609070001).

templates.body_pattern: CIMB:RM\s*(?<amount>[0-9][0-9,]*\.[0-9][0-9]) was charged to your Debit Card on [0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{2} at (?<merchant>.+)\.\s*Pls
templates.sample_input: CIMB:RM 4.00 was charged to your Debit Card on 05-09-26 at PANAXIS-SNWY CA. Pls call the no. at the back of your card for any enquiry
templates.notes: CIMB card debit; the card date carries no time of day, so txn_date is not captured and transaction_date falls back to posted_at.
Samsung Wallet card debit: "<card> - <location> <CCY> <amount>". The live row sets source_suffix_title so source_app_label reads "Samsung Wallet - HLB Debit Card".

templates.sample_input: 25.90 MYR spent at Apple. You're low on spending money. Tap to add more.
templates.notes: Wise debit card payment: "<amount> <CCY> spent at <merchant>." — amount-first, which the loose fallback does not match.
